title: Wrong Part of Town

lines.speaker: JIMMY
lines.text: Cornelius went into greaser country and didn't come back. Time for a rescue.

on_start.speaker: JOHNNY
on_start.text: Look at this little nerd, wandering into the WRONG part of town...

lines.speaker: JIMMY
lines.text: Hey, Johnny! Pick on someone your own size.

lines.speaker: JOHNNY
lines.text: Hopkins. This isn't your business — but fine. Boys, keep the nerd. We're done here.

on_complete.speaker: CORNELIUS
on_complete.text: Jimmy! Thank you! Algie's waiting by the bike racks with Chad — hurry!

on_complete.speaker: ALGIE
on_complete.text: Jimmy! The greasers are EVERYWHERE. Chad's got his bike — we have to move!

lines.speaker: CHAD
lines.text: Get on the back, Hopkins. You shoot, I drive.

stages.objective: The getaway — keep up with Chad!
stages.fail_text: You lost Chad in the chase.

on_start.speaker: CHAD
on_start.text: Ambush! On the hill — take them!

stages.objective: Walk Algie back to the nerds.

on_start.speaker: ALGIE
on_start.text: Almost home. Earnest and Cornelius are just ahead.

lines.speaker: CORNELIUS
lines.text: You pulled me out of that garage, Jimmy. I won't forget it.

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: And Algie back in one piece! The nerds are in your debt.
